import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define the labels and values
labels = ['A', 'B', 'C']
values = [3, 5, 9]

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots()

# Plot the bars
ax.bar(labels, values)

# Set the title and labels
ax.set_title('Bars for A, B, C')
ax.set_xlabel('Series')
ax.set_ylabel('Values')

# Show the plot
plt.show()
